maria: heads-up — after the kernel selection changes yesterday I'm seeing a big drop in prefix cache hit-rate for longform chat + structured-output workloads. 68% -> ~42% on prod traces. cc @kevin @raj :eyes:
kevin: whoa, that's large. which change / commit? any preliminary flamegraphs?
maria: the runtime PR is rwd/runtime#4128 (commit 9f3a2c). change moved to a different attention kernel for long seqs and tweaked batching heuristics. No full flamegraph yet, just aggregate metrics from the console.
raj: grabbing a quick sample offline. ran a sampled replay of 2k sessions clustered to the failing workload. short summary: KV cache keys got much higher cardinality post-change. Found a lot of near-duplicates (same prefix but tiny whitespace/JSON formatting diffs) -> fragmentation.
raj: paste of the quick inspection (log snippet):
